introHtml: Port Authority sweatpants are a trusted choice for bulk orders because they combine durable fabric with consistent sizing across sizes. Whether you're outfitting a warehouse team or creating branded loungewear for a company giveaway, these sweatpants hold up to repeated washing and maintain their shape. The mid-weight cotton-polyester blend works for both screen printing and embroidery, giving you flexibility in decoration. Choose from classic colors like black, navy, or heather gray to match your logo without extra setup fees.
